request.spec:
A claim may carry an external reference: a text on the claim form (surrounding spaces removed),
shown on the claim. A reference already used on the sheet, comparing without regard to case, is
refused with an error on the form, and nothing is saved; a blank reference is no reference. A
pasted line gives it at the end of its note as ` #<reference>` (a space, a hash, the reference:
that part is the reference, not part of the note), checked the same way and refusing the whole
paste on a repeat, within the paste too. CLAIM_ADDED gains ref=<reference> at its end when one was
given.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A claim may carry an external reference: a text on the claim form (surrounding spaces removed),
shown on the claim. A reference already used on the sheet, comparing without regard to case, is
refused with an error on the form, and nothing is saved; a blank reference is no reference. A
pasted line gives it at the end of its note as ` #<reference>` (a space, a hash, the reference:
that part is the reference, not part of the note), checked the same way and refusing the whole
paste on a repeat, within the paste too. CLAIM_ADDED gains ref=<reference> at its end when one was
given.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Claims can now carry an external reference, and all 4 acceptance tests pass under `bin/e2e`.

**Stored data**
- A new migration, `V44__claim_ref.sql`, adds a `ref` column to `claim`. It also adds a lower-case copy, `ref_key`, with a unique index on (sheet, `ref_key`). That stops two claims on a sheet sharing a reference even if two saves happen at once.
- The claim's edit history (`claim_edit`) now keeps the reference too, so a sheet shown as of an earlier date shows the reference the claim had then.

**Server**
- The claim form's reference has its surrounding spaces removed, and a blank one counts as no reference.
- Adding a claim with a reference already on the sheet (ignoring case) is refused and nothing is saved. Editing works the same way, except that a claim keeping its own reference is not a clash.
- **Paste:** the note has its spaces trimmed first, then a trailing ` #<reference>` is split off as the reference. A repeat against the sheet, or within the same paste, refuses the whole paste. Because of the trimming, a line whose note is just ` #inv-4` gets no reference and keeps `#inv-4` as its note, which is what the test expects.
- `CLAIM_ADDED` ends with ` ref=<reference>` when the claim has one, both for a single add and for each pasted claim.
- A claim split off another, or made by quick-add, gets no reference.

**Front end**
- The claim form has a new `claim-form-ref` field, and each claim row shows its reference in `claim-ref`.
- The editor opens with the claim's current reference filled in.
- Changing a claim's amount from its row keeps its reference.
- The error messages on the claim form and the paste box now mention references.
